This '''system''' was held by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] prior to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. The Empire hired [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] to hold the system, which they did by taking control of several [[trineutronium]] power plants on the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] main inhabited [[Unidentified planet (Inner Rim)|planet]] and threatening to detonate them&mdash;which would sterilize the planet and kill all 3.5 billion beings who lived there&mdash;if [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] ships began landing, essentially taking the entire world hostage.
